faqs.question: Are pigeon droppings dangerous to my Westfield family?
faqs.answer: Yes, pigeon droppings carry serious health risks including histoplasmosis, cryptococcosis, and E. coli bacteria. The droppings also contain uric acid that damages building materials, stains surfaces, and creates slip hazards. In Westfield's residential neighborhoods where children play outside, professional cleanup and prevention is essential. Our team uses proper protective equipment and EPA-registered disinfectants to safely remove contaminated materials and sanitize affected areas.
